title: CIA implants a chip in Lynn Kyle's skull, the origin of the tinfoil hat

tellings.quote: and unfortunately his his psychologist was worked for the CIA and they put a chip in his skull without telling him

plain: A man named Lynn Kyle is said to have had a chip put in his skull by the CIA without being told, and the story is offered as the origin of the tinfoil hat. Kurt Metzger, a guest on an episode about Jeffrey Epstein, tells it as something he heard from Kyle: Kyle's psychologist "worked for the CIA and they put a chip in his skull without telling him." Metzger also brings up the name Carlos Delgado in the story. If true, it would mean the CIA was secretly implanting devices in people's heads.
